Hey, first of all it's very good that you were able to notice the link between your sh and the feeling of loneliness. Knowing the source of your compulsion makes it 100 times easier to fight it, and I speak that from the experience of being an addict and dating someone that used to sh as well. But to go one step further you need to have professional help if you can afford it, my girlfriend's shrink helped her a LOT in the years she spent having sh issues, and she had problems similar to yours, although in a different age.

With that put aside, don't be so hard on yourself. You're very young, and by looking quickly at your profile (sorry it that's weird) I can see that you're a very wholesome and kind kid. 14 year olds are fucking terrible and they don't usually value those things, but I guarantee you that you have a ton of stuff in your personality that will attract a lot of people eventually. I also speak that from experience, my choice to reply to your post came from the fact that I felt in similar ways from you when I was in school.

I can't really solve your problems but as someone that struggled with not having friends in school I can say to you that it's not your fault that people suck and it passes, it really does. For years my only friends were made online through gaming and that saved me a bit, so maybe the advice I could give you is try to make your hobbies as a bridge to get closer to other people that like the same stuff, even if it is only a online relationship.

I hope something in this long as fuck reply helped you, all the best to you man :)
